identity.name: Matteo Giorgetti
identity.headline: Computer Science & AI student · Software, machine learning and robotics
identity.summary: Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence student at IE University, building native applications, reusable simulation tools and robotics software. AI/ML internship experience at Focoos AI and research experience at IE CyPhy Life, with projects spanning backend systems, computer vision and on-device AI.

experience.title: Research Assistant
bullets: Support fellow researchers and maintain, improve and troubleshoot shared lab systems and workflows.
Develop MOSAIC, integrating multiple projectors, robotic platforms through ROS and OptiTrack motion capture; implement spatial blending and calibration with GAMA and Python.
Work on robot fleet coordination, calibrated spatial visualization, telemetry recording and observation-only replay within MOSAIC.

experience.title: AI/ML Engineer Intern
bullets: Researched and fine-tuned open-source vision-language models for video understanding and built modular auto-labeling pipelines.
Curated datasets, designed prompts and supervision strategies, and ran controlled training, evaluation and quantization experiments using reproducible GPU workflows and human-review tools.
Documented findings and collaborated through Agile sprints, daily meetings, reviews and retrospectives.

experience.title: Research Assistant
bullets: Developed VictorIA, a robotic arm that plays Connect Four using camera input, computer vision and game-state recognition.
Designed and built MOSAIC, merging multiple off-the-shelf projectors into a unified display for real-time streaming, interactive visualization and robot debugging.
Created an automated newsletter pipeline using Gemini to analyze hundreds of technology and robotics newsletters weekly and select relevant news for lab members.
Built Unreal Engine simulations and games integrated with OptiTrack motion capture for spatial tracking of users and robots; supported fellow researchers with their experiments.

experience.title: Donation Automation Developer
bullets: Built Python automation to extract donor names from 1,000+ inconsistent donation records and enter donations in the foundation's existing platform.
Combined model-assisted extraction, caching and Selenium automation, reducing manual entry by 90% and saving an estimated 40 hours of administrative work per month.

certifications.title: AWS Educate Getting Started with Compute

noty: Developed a native macOS note application using Swift, SwiftUI and AppKit, with SQLite storage and notes attached to application windows.
Separated focus, window positioning and visibility, with recoverable editing and explicit privacy controls for optional AI access.
paddockjs: Built a reusable JavaScript/PixiJS racing simulator with composable browser views and a shared headless reset/step API.
Separated grid browsing from simulation state and exposed configurable rules and policy-evaluation interfaces. The package powers the project race on my portfolio.
whos-on-repeat: Designed and implemented a multiplayer music game as a solo course project, with a Python backend, SQLite transactions and server-timed scoring.
Separated room and game rules, protected answers until reveal, and integrated Spotify alongside an offline demo.
dream2detect: Designed and implemented the end-to-end pipeline for a group project: synthetic package images, human label review, model training and evaluation on real photographs.
The reported ensemble achieved 64.16% within one severity band on 385 real photos; exact-band accuracy was 21.04%.
vigil: Developed a robot-fleet operations dashboard using FastAPI, Paramiko and ROS interfaces, with browser-based SSH terminals.
Defined reusable diagnostic and recovery workflows, WebSocket terminal streaming and per-robot coordination to prevent conflicting jobs.
